clues.text: His mother went into labor when she heard that the Philistines had captured the ark of God.
His grandfather, a priest who judged Israel forty years, fell backward from his chair at the gate and broke his neck.
As his mother lay dying, the women beside her said, "Do not be afraid, you have a son," but she gave no answer.
His mother gave him his name, saying, "The glory has departed from Israel."
His father, Phinehas son of Eli the priest, was killed in the battle where God's ark was taken.
His brother was Ahitub, another son of Phinehas from the priestly family of Eli in Shiloh.
His nephew Ahijah wore an ephod among King Saul's six hundred men near Gibeah.
